SyncedVideoEntry.title: SyncedVideoEntry
SyncedVideoEntry.description: User video playback metadata, resume position, track selections, and offline cache status synchronized across devices.

uriString.description: Persisted SAF or media content URI string.

lastPositionMs.description: Last saved playback position in milliseconds.

audioTrackIndex.description: Selected audio track index (-1 for auto).

subtitleTrackIndex.description: Selected subtitle track index (-1 for off).

aspectMode.description: Display scaling mode for phone and car surfaces.

cachedOffline.description: Whether the media item is cached offline for low-latency playback.

mimeType.description: Media MIME type or container format.

audioDelayMs.description: Manual audio sync offset in milliseconds (-1000 to 1000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SyncedEqPreset.title: SyncedEqPreset
SyncedEqPreset.description: Custom 5-band graphic equalizer and audio FX preset synchronized across devices.

bandLevelsMb.description: Equalizer band gains in millibels (up to 10 bands).

loudnessGainMb.description: Loudness enhancer gain in millibels (0 to 1500).

activePreset.description: Whether this preset is currently selected.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when preset was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when preset was last updated.

SyncedSettings.title: SyncedSettings
SyncedSettings.description: Automotive projection quality, offline cache budget, and parked safety enforcement preferences.

autoResume.description: Whether to automatically resume last playback position.

offlineCacheLimitMb.description: Offline media cache budget in MB (256 to 16384).

parkedOnlyEnforced.description: Mandatory parked-only safety lock (must always be true).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when settings doc was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings doc was last updated.

SyncedPlaylist.title: SyncedPlaylist
SyncedPlaylist.description: User-created video playlist synchronized across devices.

videoIds.description: Ordered list of synced video document IDs in this playlist.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when playlist was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when playlist was last updated.

/users/{userId}/videos/{videoId}.description: Per-user synced video library metadata and resume positions.

/users/{userId}/eq_presets/{presetId}.description: Per-user synced graphic equalizer and audio FX presets.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: Per-user automotive projection and cache settings.
